product_summary: MSI Q Premium Calacatta Arno is an engineered quartz countertop with warm white background and gold-accented veining that mimics Calacatta marble. It's designed for homeowners wanting a low-maintenance, non-porous surface that doesn't require sealing. The product offers solid mid-market performance with MSI's extensive distribution network, though warranty coverage is weaker than premium competitors.

beats_expectations: Covers manufacturing defects under normal use
underperforms_expectations: Non-transferable warranty dies when you sell your home
Excludes any defect smaller than a dime on solid colors
surprises: Heat damage from hot pans voids warranty despite quartz being marketed as heat-resistant
Defects smaller than a quarter are considered 'inherent in fabrication process' and not covered

buyer_considerations.text: Hot pans cause permanent hazing damage that warranty doesn't cover - you'll need trivets despite heat-resistant marketing claims
Warranty becomes worthless when you sell - non-transferable unlike Cambria and other premium brands
Small veining samples don't show full slab variation - pattern matching across seams can be challenging in larger installations

serviceability_summary: Best distribution network in quartz industry with nationwide dealer coverage and Home Depot availability, though customer service quality receives mixed reviews
material_health_summary: Greenguard and NSF certified with low VOC emissions for healthy indoor air quality; no consumer health concerns during normal use (fabrication creates occupational silica hazards for installers)
